question: What vast cosmic scale is invoked to locate the supreme presence?
premises: Infinite millions of universes are invoked.
A cosmic king's tooth-tip is named as the locus.
The address is made to Śiva.
inference: The supreme presence is located at the tip of the tooth of the king of infinite millions of universes.
uncertainties: The image of the cosmic king and tooth-tip is mythic and esoteric.
plain_english: O Śiva, at the tip of the tooth of the king of infinite millions of universes.
